appKey.description: Laravel application key, either raw base64 or prefixed `base64:...`. Required on fresh install; if empty, the value stored in the existing chart Secret is kept. Never auto-generated.

reverbAppSecret.description: Laravel Reverb application secret. Required on fresh install; if empty, the value stored in the existing chart Secret is kept. Never auto-generated.

logChannel.description: Laravel log channel; must be one defined in config/logging.php. The sentry channel was removed together with the Sentry integration.
